description: This file defines the RouteResolver class in the Slim Framework, responsible for instantiating the dispatcher and computing routing results for a given URI and request method.

classes.name: Slim\Routing\RouteResolver
classes.description: Implements RouteResolverInterface to resolve routes and compute routing results based on URI and method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a RouteResolver with a route collector and optional dispatcher.

methods.name: computeRoutingResults
methods.description: Decodes the URI and dispatches it with the HTTP method to get routing results.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Looks up and returns a route by its identifier.
